# MH-01 — Book a table

**Business value:** 1000

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker

I want to book an available table for a selected date, time, and party size

So that my party has a place reserved for the meal


## Notes

A reservation defines a number of seats that are in the  same table.
If the number of seats exceedes a single table it can be spread over more than one table.

<!-- Manual clarifications below this line are preserved on regeneration. -->

## Clarifications

The required mandatory fields are:

- date
- time
- number of people

Constraints:

- the combination (date, time) can be selected from those available
- the number of people must be smaller than the seats available for (date, time)
- a hiker can reserve a seat up to 2 hours before the due time

Table assignment

- The system should, as far as possible, keep the party together, and use the smallest set of available seats available in tables.  
  In practice: the system first tries to seat the whole party at one table, possibly sharing it with other parties. It splits the party only when no single table has enough free seats, and then uses as few tables as possible, occupying the smallest available set of seats on a table.
- Sharing is the standard rule, an hiker has no option to ask for a private table.

- The rule is only one booking per time slot on a date.  
  If a hiker need more people they can modify the reservation, see story [MH-06](MH-06.md)
